layout.scope: TDG’s executed September 19, 2024 indenture for the 6% 2033 notes, with December 28, 2024 liquidity context. Annual, quarter and instrument dates remain separate. The November 15, 2027 notes mature in fiscal 2028; the reported Note 10 fiscal 2027 repayment bucket remains USD 92 million. The annual report supplies January 15, 2033 as the reported maturity; the blank day in the supplied note form does not authenticate that date. The Note 10 schedule excludes receivables financing and finance leases. It does not allocate every instrument to a fiscal bucket. Current certificates, the complete intercreditor package and forward cash inputs remain gaps. All requested panels are populated from checked live handoffs through provider-free delivery reuse. This publication is not a fresh model execution of the whole pathway or current investment clearance. No replacement analysis or Excel output.
